1. (Currently amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device having a radially expandable body into the brain to create a path; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; __radially reinforcing the device against the tissue__; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is __a therapeutic instrument configured to perform ablation, resection, or biopsy__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through a catheter or cannula within the working channel__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening, __wherein the device is inserted between white matter and gray matter tissue layers__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __such that the tissue layers are radially displaced by the expanding device__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising __maintaining the radial reinforcement of the device against the tissue during introduction of the medical element, then radially contracting and removing the device from the brain__.

7. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue; __maintaining the working channel in a stable configuration__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is __a therapeutic instrument configured to perform ablation, resection, biopsy, or tissue sampling__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through a catheter or infusion device within the working channel__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the tissue layers are radially displaced and maintained in a separated configuration__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising __maintaining the radial reinforcement during the medical procedure, then radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __prior to radial contraction and removal of the device__.

13. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; __maintaining the stent in an expanded state to provide structural support for the working channel__; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue; __treating the tissue in contact with the stent with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is __a therapeutic instrument configured to perform ablation, resection, biopsy, or tissue sampling__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through a catheter or infusion device within the working channel__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the tissue layers are radially displaced and maintained in a separated configuration by the stent__.

17. (Original) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
